normalApplicability.publicScalarConstructor: ExactScalar::new(f64), exact binary; no private quotient or multiplication API
normalApplicability.seedRule: Sphere poles and each of the six box face centers c +/- e_i have integer coordinates in the declared lattice and Inside/Outside normal side samples at offsets +/-1

seedRule: generator seed labels the upstream splitmix64-v1 draw schedule; selectors are explicit independent u64 draws, not recomputed or replaced by the producer

selectorRules.familyParameter: exact-chart success modulo 3: plane, sphere-south, sphere-north; scale-zero failure selects the same primitive; seedless failure selects sphere-south; unused elsewhere
selectorRules.formulaVariant: covering modulo 2: south-first or north-first; chord modulo 2: forward or reversed edge order with remapped triangle indices; unused elsewhere
selectorRules.intervalWidth: finite/chord modulo 2: requested chord error 0.5 or 0.75; unused elsewhere
selectorRules.multiplicity: exact-chart success modulo 4 chooses (scale,primitiveExtent)=(1,1),(2,1/2),(4,1/4),(8,1/8); mesh scale=1+(modulo 4)/4; finite/chord surface error=1+(modulo 2)/2; unused covering and exact failure
selectorRules.mutation: reserved for observer mathematical controls; unused by normal producer projection
selectorRules.observationClass: exact failure modulo 2: zero scale or missing boundary seed; mesh failure modulo 3: remove last face, reverse first face, coincide vertices 0/1; unused in success and other families
selectorRules.reserved: unused, carried by generated request only
selectorRules.sign: exact-chart success and scale-zero failure center multiplied by +1 for even, -1 for odd; mesh x shift has the same sign rule; unused elsewhere
selectorRules.value: sourceRevision=cad-<domainCaseIndex hex16>-<value hex16> for all families; exact success and scale-zero failure modulo 4 chooses center zero,x-unit,x-two,xy-unit; mesh absolute x shift=(modulo 4)/2

wireIntegerRule: seed, indices and selectors are exactly 16 lowercase hexadecimal digits
